title: PaymentSettled
description: Published to topic payments.settled by settlement-service once a payment has settled. Consumed by ledger-service.

paymentId.description: Unique payment id. Also the Kafka record key.

amount.description: Settled amount in major units (pounds), e.g. 12.34. Being replaced by amountMinor.

amountMinor.description: Settled amount in minor units (pence), e.g. 1234 for £12.34.
